system.description:
• Untitled, unsponsored knights, some left without a lord and others self-made in battle. No keep, no banner, just the code they chose.
  • Steadfast Courage: your Embolden option reaches 60ft, and companions and followers in range have Advantage on all saves.
  • Common Ground: Advantage on Charisma checks when dealing with common folk, mercenaries, or anyone who distrusts titled nobility.

features.name: Steadfast Courage
features.description: Your Embolden option reaches 60ft, and companions and followers in range have Advantage on all saves. When you give Embolden, apply this in place of the usual Emboldened.

features.name: Common Ground
features.description: Advantage on Charisma checks when dealing with common folk, mercenaries, or anyone who distrusts titled nobility.

rules.when: with common folk, mercenaries, or anyone who distrusts titled nobility
